paragraphs.text: He prophecies that God's benefits in calling the Gentiles will be so great that they will have wonderful opportunity to praise his mercy and rejoice.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: He chiefly means concerning spiritual regeneration, by which we are his sheep and people.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He shows that God will not be worshipped, but by those means which he has appointed.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving

paragraphs.text: He declares that we should never be weary in praising him, seeing his mercies toward us last forever.
paragraphs.label: d
